VnPay._comment: Publicly published VNPay sandbox demo credentials (not secrets). Self-register at https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/devreg/ for a dedicated pair before relying on this for real testing.

Momo._comment: Publicly published Momo sandbox demo credentials (not secrets). Self-register at https://developers.momo.vn for a dedicated pair before relying on this for real testing.

R2._comment: Cloudflare R2 bucket for product images. BucketName/PublicBaseUrl aren't secret (PublicBaseUrl is embedded in every product's image URL anyway). AccountId/AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey are real credentials and must only live in appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) or environment variables — never here.
